name: Distilling Kimi-K3.1-Pro into Qwen3.8-27B: Teaching a model a new language
title: Distilling Kimi-K3.1-Pro into Qwen3.8-27B: Teaching a model a new language
headline: Together AI distills Lao translation into Qwen3.8-27B
lede: Teams can use Together AI's published code and cost breakdown to distill Lao translation from Kimi-K3.1-Pro into Qwen3.8-27B at 93% of teacher quality with Thai intact.

effects.effect: Published code and cost numbers make custom post-training easier to budget.
Shows targeted distillation can patch low-resource language gaps in 27B models.

appearances.summary: Qwen3.8-27B answered in Thai when asked for Lao. We distilled Kimi-K3.1-Pro's Lao translation into it with Together Post-Training: 93% of the teacher's score, with Thai intact. Code and costs included.
